Libolo]] | years13 = 2015 | team13 = [[BC Zepter Vienna|Zepter Vienna]] | cyears1 = 2021 | cteam1 = [[Indy Express]] | highlights = * [[National Basketball League (Bulgaria)|Bulgarian League]] All-Star (2012) | medaltemplates = {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Africa Clubs Champions Cup]]}} {{MedalGold|[[2014 FIBA Africa Clubs Champions Cup|Tunis 2014]]|[[Recreativo do Libolo Basketball|Rec do Libolo]]}} }} '''Andre Liroy Owens''' (born October 31, 1980) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player who played briefly in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball|Indiana Hoosiers]] and [[Houston Cougars men's basketball|Houston Cougars]]. ==High school and college basketball== A {{convert|6|ft|4|in|m|adj=on}} guard, he played competitively at [[Perry Meridian High School]] where he was an Indiana All-Star in his senior season.{{cite news |url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/112567676/big3-the-perfect-number-for-owens/ |title=BIG3 the perfect number for Owens |first=Kyle |last=Neddenriep |work=[[Indianapolis Star]] |department=Sports |page=[https://www.newspapers.com/clip/112567676/big3-the-perfect-number-for-owens/ 1C], [https://www.newspapers.com/clip/112567682/big3-the-perfect-number-for-owens/ 4C] |date=July 17, 2017 |accessdate=November 5, 2022 |via=[[Newspapers.com]]}} Owens attended [[Indiana University]] and then transferred to the [[University of Houston]]. ==Professional career== [[NBA draft|Undrafted]], he signed with the [[Utah Jazz]] as a [[free agent]] prior to the start of the [[2005-06 NBA season]]. He was traded to the [[Golden State Warriors]] along with [[Devin Brown]] and [[Keith McLeod]] in exchange for [[Derek Fisher]] on July 12, 2006.[http://www.nba.com/warriors/news/Warriors_Aquire_Brown_McLeod_Owens.html WARRIORS: Warriors Acquire Devin Brown, Keith McLeod and Andre Owens From Utah] In October 2006, he was released by the Warriors without playing in any preseason games.{{Cite web |url=http://www.rotoworld.com/content/playerpages/playerbreakingnews.asp?sport=NBA&id=1219&line=69525&spln=1 |title=Fantasy Basketball Breaking News - Rotoworld.com |access-date=2006-10-28 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070927225858/http://www.rotoworld.com/content/playerpages/playerbreakingnews.asp?sport=NBA&id=1219&line=69525&spln=1 |archive-date=2007-09-27 |url-status=dead }} The [[Indiana Pacers]] signed Owens to a one-year deal on July 4, 2007.[http://www.pacerslocker.com/2007/07/04/the-indiana-pacers-sign-andre-owens/ Indiana Pacers sign Andre Owens] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070929212523/http://www.pacerslocker.com/2007/07/04/the-indiana-pacers-sign-andre-owens/ |date=September 29, 2007 }} In September 2008 he moved to Europe, signing a one-year contract with Serbian [[Adriatic League]] team [[KK Crvena zvezda|Crvena zvezda]].[http://www.talkbasket.net/news/andre-owens-signed-for-red-star.html Andre Owens signed for Red Star] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080913202758/http://www.talkbasket.net/news/andre-owens-signed-for-red-star.html |date=2008-09-13 }} In 2009, he signed with [[Türk Telekom B.K.]] in [[Ankara]].[http://www.sportando.net/eng/europa/eurocup/3790/turk_telekom_signed_also_andre_owens.html Turk Telekom signed also Andre Owens] In 2009, he signed with [[Lokomotiv Kuban]] in [[Krasnodar]] ([[Russian Basketball Super League]]). In October 2010 he signed a one-month contract with [[Bàsquet Manresa]],{{usurped|1=[https://web.archive.org/web/20120310231946/http://www.thehoopsmarket.com/news/assignia-manresa-signs-andre-owens.aspx Assignia Manresa signs Andre Owens]}} and after his contract expired in November he signed with [[CB Granada]] until the end of the 2010–11 season,[http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=72141 El CB Granada ficha a Andre Owens hasta final de temporada] {{in lang|es}} but left the team in March 2011.[http://www.granadahoy.com/article/deportes/918770/andre/owens/otro/decide/abandonar/barco.html Andre Owens, otro que decide abandonar el 'barco'] {{in lang|es}} He then signed with the Ukrainian club [[BC Donetsk]].[http://www.beobasket.net/page/news/sr.html?view=story&id=23472§ionId=1 ANDRE OWENS POTPISAO UGOVOR U UKRAJINI] {{in lang|sr}} In December 2014, he signed with [[C.R.D. Libolo]] of Angola.[https://www.afrobasket.com/Angola/basketball.aspx?NewsID=384883 Libolo tabs Andre Owens] On February 27, 2015, he signed with [[BC Zepter Vienna|Zepter Vienna]] of the [[Österreichische Basketball Bundesliga]].[http://www.eurobasket.com/Austria/news/396112/Vienna-adds-Andre-Owens,-Ex-NBA Vienna adds Andre Owens, Ex-NBA] In the summer of 2017, he played in the BIG3 League for 3's Company.{{Cite web|url=https://big3.com/teams/3s-company|title=3s Company|website=big3.com|language=en-gb|access-date=2017-07-17}} He was named the GM of the [[Indy Express]].[https://www.usbasket.com/TBL/news/603858/Andre-Owens-named-GM-for-Indy-Express,-Andre Owens named GM for Indy Express] == NBA career statistics == {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===
